svg.title: Mean response time by configuration and workload class
svg.desc: Grouped bars with 95% confidence intervals for eight scheduling configurations across five workload classes.
svg.text: Step 1: mean response time by configuration and workload class
Bars: mean over 10 trials (seeds base+0..9), context-switch cost 1 tu. Error bars: 95% Student-t confidence interval. Lower is better.
